description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements a logging utility wrapper around Android's native Log class. It facilitates structured and chainable logging, allowing logs to be forwarded to subsequent LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for Android's native Log utility implementing the LogNode interface, allowing for logging with chaining capability.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with given priority, tag, and optional Throwable; forwards log to the next node if present.
